policy: Card lifecycle, season availability and current live wording are separate from old-season guides. When live wording conflicts with launch guides, WfGg stores the conflict and does not silently apply the stale rule.

core.note: Owned Core Cards persist and remain usable in off-season.

regular.note: Regular cards disappear/become inactive in off-season. Their exact catalog is season-dependent.

globalExpedition.mainEffectRule: Do not assume a card's own main effect works in Global Expedition when current live wording says PvP-only. Total equipped non-Core levels still feed the separate Expedition bonus system.
globalExpedition.conflictNote: Early Season 6 guides described the three new Universal cards as PvP + Global Expedition. Current live card text indexed by Last War Archive says PvP-only for their main effects. WfGg follows current displayed card text and requires in-game confirmation before applying those main effects to Expedition.

nonCombatAndRewardCards.rule: Keep these in the inventory catalog, but do not let resource/reward effects distort combat recommendations. Secondary random combat attributes are modeled separately.

randomSecondaryAttributes.reason: Two copies of the same card can materially differ because secondary traits can add PvP Attack/Defense/HP, counter damage reduction, card levels, profession XP, etc.
